_comment: This is an example config. install.sh creates a working controller/config.json with passwords filled in. The twitch_url and backup_file fields need to be edited manually.
_comment_output: The controller determines the backup video's resolution/fps/channels itself via ffprobe of the live stream on every broadcast start -- no need to set them here. These two fields only affect the QUALITY of the one-time backup transcode (when it doesn't match live): the video/audio bitrate of the resulting backup.prepared.mp4.
